title: Spine: Compiling Subtask Trees into Structured Context for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon coding tasks contain nested subtasks. Typically, agents record interactions sequentially into a growing history, causing context inflation and performance degradation. Compressing or trimming the history without explicit subtask boundaries can discard information needed by unfinished subtasks. Conversely, recursive subagent delegation isolates completed subtasks through child agents by assigning every subtask boundary to delegation, which conflates subtask granularity with executing agent choice, adding execution and coordination overhead. We introduce Spine, an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion. An agent declares explicit subtask boundaries through work scopes, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline while reserving delegation for independent parallel tasks. The runtime organizes execution in SpineTree, a persistent tree recording subtask relations, local

translated_title: Spine：将子任务树编译为结构化上下文以支持长程编码智能体
translated_abstract: 长程编码任务包含嵌套的子任务。通常情况下，智能体将交互按顺序记录到不断增长的历史中，导致上下文膨胀和性能下降。在缺乏显式子任务边界的情况下压缩或裁剪历史，可能会丢弃未完成子任务所需的信息。相反，递归的子智能体委派方式通过子智能体来隔离已完成的子任务，将每一个子任务边界都交由委派处理，这混淆了子任务粒度与执行智能体的选择，增加了执行与协调开销。我们提出了 Spine，这是一个将模型上下文与子任务嵌套及完成情况对齐的接口与运行时。智能体通过“工作范围”声明显式的子任务边界，使同一个智能体能够内联执行嵌套子任务，同时将委派保留给独立的并行任务。该运行时以 SpineTree 来组织执行过程——这是一棵持久化的树，记录子任务之间的关系、局部……
tldr: Spine 通过让智能体用“工作范围”显式声明子任务边界，将子任务树编译为持久化的结构化上下文，在不依赖子智能体委派的情况下对齐长程编码任务的嵌套结构与模型上下文，避免上下文膨胀。
